ground_truth.description: The new Stage 1 text asserts that 'Stage 3's triple-filter verification' will otherwise 'falsely report "Stage 1 summary missing"', implying Stage 3 verifies the Stage 1 cycle summary (stage='memory_consolidator'). But the stage3.py changes in this diff only add/keep a check for the Stage 2 summary (stage='task_knowledge_sync'); Stage 3 is never given a path to verify the Stage 1 summary. This is a dangling reference to a verification that does not exist, so the newly-written Stage 1 summary's persistence is never actually confirmed downstream — the plausible source of the escalation despite a passing review.

Requiring the disambiguating key 'stage':'task_knowledge_sync' in Path 2 means Stage 2 summaries written after task 1588 but before task 9af436fe (they have run_id but no stage) now count as 0 under the triple filter. This silently narrows Path 2 coverage and re-exposes those legacy summaries to exactly the low-cosine semantic-search false-negative (run 80a85eeb / memory 91e6a3b9 at relevance 0.71) that Path 2 was introduced to eliminate, for that legacy window.

The verify-then-retry instruction ('confirm it returns >= 1 ... A return of 0 means ... retry the add_memory write once') assumes count_memories_by_metadata is immediately consistent with the just-completed add_memory. If Qdrant metadata indexing lags the write (read-after-write delay), the count can transiently return 0 even though the write persisted, and the mandated retry then creates a duplicate cycle summary — the same duplicate-per-cycle entry the surrounding text warns later cycles must clean up. The same pattern was added to stage2.py:227-233.

task.title: Fix stage1.py (memory_consolidator): add metadata.stage='memory_consolidator' to cycle summary writes
task.description: Stage 1 cycle summary for run 0a05e493-5dc2-482d-b384-fe92100b7b6f was written without metadata.stage='memory_consolidator'. Triple-filter check {kind: cycle_summary, run_id: 0a05e493, stage: memory_consolidator} returns 0. This causes false 'Stage 1 summary missing' signals in Stage 3's triple-filter verification path. Stage 2 already has the correct metadata.stage field (fixed in run 9af436fe); Stage 1 needs the same treatment.
task.details: Fix: In stage1.py (memory_consolidator), update the per-cycle summary add_memory call to include metadata={'kind': 'cycle_summary', 'run_id': run_id, 'stage': 'memory_consolidator'}. After the fix, add a post-write self-check using count_memories_by_metadata with the triple filter {kind: cycle_summary, run_id: run_id, stage: memory_consolidator} to verify the stage key persisted. This mirrors the Stage 2 pattern fixed in task 9af436fe. Flagged by Stage 1 analytical finding b87b9d49 in know_live run 511e0a0a.
